scan_angles: arXiv: PEAD + post-earnings drift + text signals

papers_found.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading
papers_found.relevance_note: LLM semantic pair selection — different failure mode than H307 cointegration. High-level + low-level RL policies both LLM-parameterized. No specific US Sharpe metrics in abstract. Staged as wiki update on pairs-trading.md.

papers_found.title: FinBERT2: A Specialized Bidirectional Encoder for Finance-Specific LLM Deployment
papers_found.relevance_note: Direct upgrade candidate for ProsusAI/finbert in H163/H174 PEAD pipeline. +0.4–3.3% vs FinBERT on classification, +9.7–12.3% vs GPT-4 class. Caveat: Chinese corpus — English performance unverified. Staged as wiki update + H312 hypothesis note.

papers_found.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization with Bias Correction
papers_found.relevance_note: 213-factor ML system; tradability mask = single largest performance driver (+0.44 Sharpe). Sharpe 2.05 IS / 1.63 OOS China A-share. Bias correction lesson directly applicable to H217/H228 alpha101 pipeline. Staged as wiki update on design-principles.md.

papers_found.title: Generative AI for Stock Selection
papers_found.relevance_note: RAG + LLM auto-discovers stock features from analyst reports + options + price-volume. 14-91% Sharpe improvement vs baselines. Weakly correlated with traditional factors → stackable with H198/H217/H228. Staged as H312 hypothesis seed in CLAUDE.local.md.

papers_found.title: Toward Reliable Evaluation of LLM-Based Financial Multi-Agent Systems: Taxonomy, Coordination Primacy, and Cost Awareness
papers_found.relevance_note: Already covered in wiki/trading/tools/multi-agent-llm-trading.md. No new actionable content.

papers_found.title: FactorEngine: A Program-level Knowledge-Infused Factor Mining Framework
papers_found.relevance_note: Interesting LLM factor mining via code generation. No specific Sharpe numbers visible in abstract; no GitHub. Similar to Alpha-GPT (already in wiki). Skip until code/results available.

papers_found.title: QuantaAlpha: An Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
papers_found.relevance_note: Evolutionary LLM alpha mining; IC 0.0472, S&P 500 19.1% excess return over 4 years via transfer from CSI 300. China-first approach. No GitHub. IC 0.047 is moderate. No Sharpe. Skip until US-native results published.

papers_found.title: Semi-Static Variance-Optimal Hedging of Covariance Risk in Multi-Asset Derivatives
papers_found.relevance_note: Geometric dispersion trades; semi-static replication using Fourier transforms for covariance swaps. Theoretical framework. Already incorporated into spx-dispersion-variance.md wiki page (Phase 1 wiki expansion). Not separately staged.

papers_found.title: Momentum-integrated Multi-task Stock Recommendation with Converge-based Optimization
papers_found.relevance_note: Multi-task learning with momentum integration. No specific Sharpe metrics visible. Competing with H228 (alpha101+reversal, OOS 1.572). Would need strong results to justify new hypothesis. Skip.

papers_found.title: Python quantitative trading strategies (quant-trading repo)
papers_found.relevance_note: Classic strategies (VIX, pairs, MACD, etc.) — all strategies in this repo are already implemented or tested in Kevin's pipeline. No novel angles.

papers_found.title: Dispersion Trading using Options — Python implementation
papers_found.relevance_note: Closest available reference implementation for H309 Phase 2. Uses straddle/strangle on top-N SPX components with delta hedging via futures. z1/z2/z3 correlation percentile thresholds. Incorporated into spx-dispersion-variance.md wiki page. Not separately staged.

summary: Strong night for PEAD upgrades and cross-sectional alpha. FinBERT2 (KDD 2026) is the most actionable finding — direct replacement candidate for H163/H174 pipeline. ML tradability mask insight from arXiv:2507.07107 is an important bias-correction principle applicable to the entire alpha101 stack. Generative AI stock selection (arXiv:2602.00196) is stackable with existing confirmed strategies. Moira LLM pairs is monitored as a possible post-H307 revival approach. No dispersion trading arXiv papers with working code found — H309 Phase 2 remains blocked on Polygon options data subscription.
